INSERT INTO users (email, role, is_active, password_hash)
        VALUES ($1, 'admin', true, $2)
        ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET
            role = 'admin',
            is_active = true,
            password_hash = EXCLUDED.password_hash,
            failed_login_attempts = 0,
            locked_until = NULL
        RETURNING id, (xmax = 0) AS "created!"
